bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
work="$repo/.worktrees/video-two-topic-20261124"
test -d "$work" || exit 71
cd "$work"
set +e
docker build -q -f artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs -t gace-video-two-topic-pins:20261124 . > /tmp/video-two-build-20261124.log 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
if test "$status" -eq 0; then echo BUILD_PASS; exit 0; fi
if grep -Eiq 'failed to fetch|TLS handshake|network is unreachable|temporary failure|connection refused|timeout|certificate' /tmp/video-two-build-20261124.log; then exit 81; fi
if grep -Eiq 'ERR_PNPM|pnpm|npm ERR|install' /tmp/video-two-build-20261124.log; then exit 82; fi
if grep -Eiq 'error:|ERROR:|Could not resolve|No matching export|build failed' /tmp/video-two-build-20261124.log; then exit 83; fi
if grep -Eiq 'permission denied|cannot connect to the Docker daemon' /tmp/video-two-build-20261124.log; then exit 84; fi
exit 85
